            LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (Research.BlockDotProduct.treeDepth n T))) u) 1 →
              LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Research.BlockDotProduct.errorIndex n T)) u) 1 →
                ∃ Δx Δy,
                  And
                    (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockDotProduct.computedDot T x y e)
                      (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (Δx i)) (y i)))
                    (And
